notes:
Original full primary paper obtained as HTML transcription; title/authors/DOI verified. Its OCR uses p for equals, ! for less than, and 1 for greater than; quoted OCR is retained verbatim. Replication is the author-hosted full published PDF. Original study 2 and replication section 7.1 are independently matched. Replication analytic N is the sum of printed condition ns, not the overall 1018 sample. No p value inferred from an F bound. Certainty Conditions interpreted as the main effect of certainty. Requested replication partial eta-squared is not printed for the certainty main effect; the printed F bound is retained instead, without converting it. No explicit author narrative replication-success verdict for this main effect.
Completion source review (n_r): Final mutually exclusive certainty groups in the direct-replication subset establish participant N; primary analyses retain all participants.
Completion source review (es_value_r): Retained the printed metric and precision for the described test.
